title: Animated illustration characters

location.extent: Complete published clip; PNG is a frame at 0.5 seconds

slide_intent: Give illustration a repeatable movement character because a playful world needs continuity between scenes.
strategic_value: Loose outlines and patterned fills can make Dropbox’s creative stance feel human and varied.
demonstration: The clip sequences a running animal, a walking bus-like creature, floating objects, a balloon-carrying crocodile and figures on a board, all drawn with black outlines and colored patterns.
practical_value: Compare how line, fill and motion remain related across different characters.

content_islands.name: Character episodes
content_islands.spec: Sequence the separate figures on white without treating them as one fixed character.

content_islands.name: Graphic language
content_islands.spec: Preserve the loose black strokes, sparse ground lines and bright patterned patches.
